title: Auth Identity Enterprise Proof Depth Matrix
authorityNote: Machine-checkable source-issue evidence for the USF-149 auth and identity enterprise-depth slice. Linear tracks work only; repository evidence and validators govern proof claims.
nonClaims: No live IdP, live broker, browser UI, SIEM forwarding, production, staging, deployment, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full React parity, enterprise production readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
Hermetic Keycloak-equivalent proof does not prove live external identity provider readiness.
Local browser-flow semantic checks do not prove browser UI or real cookie issuance readiness.
Local audit threat signals do not prove live SIEM forwarding or incident readiness.

controls.whatIsProven: Synthetic tenant SSO connection request, domain verification, separate approval, activation, suspension/revocation primitives, PDP gate, and value-free audit evidence are exercised by make auth-proof.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No public API route, browser UI, live Keycloak admin API, external IdP broker configuration, or production operation is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: A requester cannot approve the same SSO connection, and a different active tenant admin approval is required before activation.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No executed customer access review, operator console workflow, or production privileged-access review cadence is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: JIT provisioning is explicit per tenant SSO connection, blocks privileged role grants, and produces pending or non-privileged membership posture only.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No live unknown-user creation, IdP group sync, SCIM lifecycle, or production onboarding operation is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: Domain ownership is required before SSO activation and a cross-tenant domain claim collision fails closed.
controls.whatIsNotProven: Live DNS TXT, well-known HTTP challenge, certificate, email, or registrar evidence is not proven.
controls.followUpIssue: USF-193 for readiness semantics before stronger environment claims

controls.whatIsProven: Synthetic invitations carry expiry, required domain, assurance requirement, brokered-identity requirement, actor-bound acceptance, and expired invitation denial.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No email delivery, user UI, live IdP enrollment, SCIM, or production onboarding readiness is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: The assurance ladder denies privileged operations below required LoA and accepts higher assurance without using token claims as authorization.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No live MFA challenge, WebAuthn, device posture, browser step-up, or production authentication flow is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: Account linking requires proof-of-control assurance and unlinking fails closed when it would remove the last active login method.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No live upstream account linking, browser re-auth UX, support recovery, or production identity recovery is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: Attribute and group mapping is allow-listed, value-free, tenant-scoped, PDP-gated, and never grants roles directly.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No live IdP claim mapping, SCIM group sync, production role mapping, or customer-admin UI is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: Tenant SSO request, configure, verify, activate, suspend, revoke, rotate-secret, update-mapping, and view-audit actions are explicitly permissioned and fail closed when absent.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No operator console, production access review, live Keycloak admin API, public exposure, or break-glass operation is proven.

controls.whatIsProven: State, nonce, PKCE, CSRF, redirect allow-list, post-logout redirect allow-list, secure cookie flags, and refresh-rotation requirement are checked as local semantic policy.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No browser UI, HTTP callback route, real Set-Cookie header, refresh-token rotation runtime, Playwright journey, or production cookie operation is proven.
controls.followUpIssue: USF-155 for API/gateway surfaces where authorised

controls.whatIsProven: Security threat signals are emitted as value-free local audit events and explicitly report no live SIEM claim.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No Sentry, SIEM, alert routing, incident workflow, on-call, or production threat-detection operation is proven.
controls.followUpIssue: USF-159 and USF-179 for observability and incident depth

controls.whatIsProven: USF accepts only Keycloak-issued tokens in hermetic proof and rejects brokered-upstream issuers presented directly.
controls.whatIsNotProven: No live Keycloak admin API, live OIDC discovery, live JWKS rotation endpoint, live external broker, upstream IdP, supplier/subprocessor, or live-provider readiness is proven.
controls.followUpIssue: USF-193 for environment promotion semantics before stronger claims; future live-provider issue required before live integration
